issues.reason: Institutional 'recognizes' is an act of acknowledgment, not a stative psych/perception state — the instruction set moves a transitive subject off Agent for exactly two classes (possession, and stative psych/perception bounded by the progressive test, listing the eventive neighbours 'discover, notice, realise' as ordinary Agents) and states that stativity alone never demotes a transitive subject ('the manifest lists two pallets').

defect_summary: The compliant form is (Agent sk_recognize_1 sk_council_1) with (Theme sk_recognize_1 sk_marker_1) — the markers are acknowledged, not changed, so the object takes Theme by the does-it-change test.
notes: Everything else is right: the capitalized bare class label takes no Name atom, the counted plural gets GroupOf + Cardinality 3, calendar_marker exposes only its head genus, and the habitual present carries no status atom.
